description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and validating filesystem paths within a project, including handling symbolic links, path validation, and directory/file existence checks.

methods.name: canUseNodeFs
methods.description: Checks if the Node.js 'fs' module can be used by verifying if 'getBuiltinModule' is available.

methods.name: invalidPath
methods.description: Returns an error object indicating a path is invalid within a given scope.

methods.name: resolveRealPathIfExists
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a given target if it exists.

methods.name: resolveTrustedRootRealPath
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a root directory if it exists and is a directory, not a symlink.

methods.name: validateCanonicalPathWithinRoot
methods.description: Validates that a candidate path is within the root directory and matches expected type (file or directory).

methods.name: resolvePathWithinRoot
methods.description: Resolves a requested path within a root directory, ensuring it stays within scope.

methods.name: resolveWritablePathWithinRoot
methods.description: Resolves a writable path within a root directory, validating parent and target paths.

methods.name: resolvePathsWithinRoot
methods.description: Resolves multiple requested paths within a root directory.

methods.name: resolveExistingPathsWithinRoot
methods.description: Resolves multiple existing paths within a root directory, allowing missing paths.

methods.name: resolveStrictExistingPathsWithinRoot
methods.description: Resolves multiple existing paths within a root directory, requiring all to exist.

methods.name: resolveCheckedPathsWithinRoot
methods.description: Internal function to resolve paths with additional checks, including fallback handling.
